info.title: ApiToolKit - Google Business Profile APIs
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for Business Profile APIs: accounts, locations (Business Information API), categories, reviews and replies, local posts, and performance metrics (Performance API). Connect a Google account with GET /api/businessprofile/auth/url?accountKey=..., then pass the same accountKey to every endpoint.

get.summary: List Business Profile accounts for the signed-in user.

post.summary: Create a location group or organization account.

get.summary: Get one Business Profile account.
List admins of an account.

put.summary: Change the role of an account admin.

delete.summary: Remove an admin from an account.

get.summary: List pending invitations for an account.
Get the Pub/Sub notification setting of an account (Notifications API).

put.summary: Set the Pub/Sub topic and notification types for an account.

get.summary: Get the Google OAuth 2.0 consent URL. accountKey is any name you choose for this Google account; reuse it on every other endpoint.
OAuth 2.0 callback. Google sends the code and the accountKey (as state); tokens are stored for that account key.

post.summary: Refresh the stored access token for an account key.
